Season|LPL 2020 Summer]]. * Fans often joke about his looks being very similar to Chinese singer [[wikipedia:en:Joker Xue|Xue Zhiqian]] (薛之谦). === Statistics === * Reached 1000 kills in the LPL on March 11, 2022. ** The 30th player to reach 1000 kills in the LPL. * Reached 1500 kills in the LPL on April 15, 2023. ** The 19th player to reach 1500 kills in the LPL. * Reached 2000 kills in the LPL on April 11, 2024. ** The 13th player to reach 2000 kills in the LPL. * Reached 2500 kills in the LPL on April 28, 2025. ** The 9th player to reach 2500 kills in the LPL. * Reached 3000 kills in the LPL on September 15, 2025. ** The 6th player to reach 3000 kills in the LPL. * Reached 500 games in the LPL on February 23, 2025 ** The 29th player to reach 500 games in the LPL. * Reached 600 games in the LPL on August 13, 2025 ** The 18th player to reach 600 games in the LPL. * Reached 300 wins in the LPL on March 26, 2025. ** Was the 23rd player to reach 300 wins in the LPL. * Reached 3000 assists in the LPL on April 06, 2025. ** Was the 35th player to reach 3000 assists in the LPL. * Reached 500 international kills during [[Worlds 2025 Main Event|Worlds 2025]] on October 24, 2025 in Round 4 of Swiss Stage, becoming the 10th player to achieve this milestone after [[Faker]], [[Perkz]], [[xiaohu]], [[Caps]], [[Maple (Huang Yi-Tang) | Maple]], [[GALA]], [[Gumayusi]], [[Bin (Chen Ze-Bin)|Bin]], and [[Ruler]]. {{PlayerStatsTrivia}} ===Individual Awards=== * LPL 1st All-Pro Team x1 (Spring 2024) * LPL 2nd All-Pro Team x2 (Spring 2023, Summer 2023) * LPL 3rd All-Pro Team x2 (Summer 2020, Summer 2021, Split 3 2025) * LPL Finals MVP x1 (Spring 2024) * LPL Outstanding Rookie (Summer 2020) == Tournament Results == {{PlayerResults|show=overviewpage}}
